title: validateAnswers() rejects a select-type answer with more than one value
description: smart-compliance.service.js validateAnswers() enforces that a question with responseType 'select' has exactly one answer value; only 'multiselect' may have more.
steps: Load a question document with responseType='select' and 3 options
Call validateAnswers() with an answer array containing 2 of the option values for that question
expectedResult: Returned errors array contains one entry for that answer with message '"<question text>" requires exactly one answer'.

title: validateAnswers() flags a duplicate questionId across the submitted answers array
steps: Build an answers array with the same questionId appearing at index 0 and index 3
Call validateAnswers() with the corresponding loaded question list
expectedResult: Returned errors array includes an entry for 'answers[3].questionId' with message 'Duplicate questionId'.

title: validateAnswers() rejects an answer value that is not one of the question's option values
steps: Load a question whose options are [{value:'yes'},{value:'no'}]
Call validateAnswers() with answer array ['maybe'] for that question
expectedResult: Returned errors array contains 'Invalid option(s): maybe' for that answer, since 'maybe' is not in the question.options value set.

title: clamp() coerces out-of-range or non-numeric LLM confidence/valueScore into the 0-100 band
description: smart-compliance.service.js clamp(val,min,max) is applied to every confidence and valueScore field returned by the LLM before persistence, since the model is not guaranteed to respect the requested numeric range.
steps: Call clamp(150, 0, 100) and confirm it returns 100
Call clamp(-20, 0, 100) and confirm it returns 0
Call clamp('n/a', 0, 100) and confirm it returns 50 (the floor of the min/max midpoint)
expectedResult: All three calls return values within [0,100]; the non-numeric input falls back to the midpoint (50) rather than NaN.

title: applyDepthLevel('names_only') strips scoring/reasoning fields and nulls overallAnalysis
description: Plan-tiered depthLevel config controls how much of the LLM recommendation is exposed. 'names_only' is the most restrictive tier.
preconditions: A recommendation object with 2 supportedFrameworks, each carrying valueScore, implementationEffort, priority, reasoning, plus a non-null overallAnalysis
expectedResult: Every entry in recommendation.supportedFrameworks no longer has valueScore/implementationEffort/priority/reasoning keys, and recommendation.overallAnalysis is null. frameworkName/frameworkId/confidence remain untouched.

title: buildUserMessage() truncates question text longer than 70 characters with an ellipsis
description: Token-efficiency measure in the prompt builder — verifies the truncation boundary is applied per-question, not to the whole message.
steps: Build a questionnaireSnapshot containing one question with an 90-character question string
Call buildUserMessage(snapshot, frameworks, ctrlMap) and inspect the RESPONSES section
expectedResult: The rendered line shows only the first 70 characters of the question followed by a single '…' character before the '→' separator.

title: effort() and priority() normalizers fall back to 'medium' for any value outside their enum
expectedResult: All four calls return 'medium' — an LLM hallucinating a value outside ['easy','medium','hard'] or ['low','medium','high'] never propagates an invalid enum value into SCResponse.

title: addRecommendedFramework() reactivates an archived ClientFramework entry instead of creating a duplicate
description: Guards against duplicate active framework rows when a user removes then re-adds the same framework via a Smart Compliance recommendation.
preconditions: A ClientFramework document exists for (orgId, projectId, frameworkId) with status='archived' and a non-null revokedAt
expectedResult: No new ClientFramework document is created. The existing document's status is set to 'active', revokedAt is cleared to null, and addedBy/addedAt are updated to the current user/timestamp.
